clips.text: Water, trees, rocks, and air are natural resources. A chair is a product made from resources.
One product may use several resources, such as wood, metal, water, and energy.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Water, trees, rocks, and air are natural resources. A chair is a product made from resources.
Use and care. One product may use several resources, such as wood, metal, water, and energy.
Which is a manufactured product? Choose one answer. A. River water B. A wooden chair C. A growing tree
Build your explanation.
A wooden chair is a product made from natural resources.
Forests supply wood, fruit, and other plant products. They also provide habitats and help protect soil.
Trees can regrow, but regrowth takes time. Forest care includes habitats, soil, water, and responsible harvesting.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Forests supply wood, fruit, and other plant products. They also provide habitats and help protect soil.
Use and care. Trees can regrow, but regrowth takes time. Forest care includes habitats, soil, water, and responsible harvesting.

Build your explanation.

Wood can become furniture, building lumber, paper pulp, and tools. Wood can also be burned for heat.
Burning wood uses up the material and releases smoke and carbon dioxide. A usable board can sometimes be repaired or reused first.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Wood can become furniture, building lumber, paper pulp, and tools. Wood can also be burned for heat.

Build your explanation.

Soil supports crops. Roots take in water and minerals; leaves use light to make food. Crops can become food and plant materials.
Protecting soil from erosion helps protect a resource needed for growing crops.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Soil supports crops. Roots take in water and minerals; leaves use light to make food. Crops can become food and plant materials.
Use and care. Protecting soil from erosion helps protect a resource needed for growing crops.

Build your explanation.

People use water for drinking, washing, growing crops, making products, and cooling some power plants. These uses need different treatment.

Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. People use water for drinking, washing, growing crops, making products, and cooling some power plants. These uses need different treatment.
Use and care. The water cycle continues, but clean freshwater is limited by place, time, pollution, and treatment capacity.

Build your explanation.

Stone can be cut for building. Clay can be shaped and fired into bricks. Suitable silica sand with other ingredients can be melted to make glass.

Inspect the source and use records.

Build your explanation.
Natural materials need suitable processing to become many useful products.

Metal recovery still needs collection and energy. Recycling metals can reduce the need for new ore extraction.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Ores contain useful minerals. Processing can produce iron, copper, or aluminum. Copper is used in wiring; aluminum in cans; steel in buildings.

Crude oil is processed in refineries. Products include gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, asphalt, lubricants, and feedstocks for many plastics and synthetic fibers.

Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Crude oil is processed in refineries. Products include gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, asphalt, lubricants, and feedstocks for many plastics and synthetic fibers.

Build your explanation.

Coal can be burned to produce heat for electricity generation. Certain coal is processed into coke used in many ironmaking processes.
Not all steelmaking uses coal-derived coke. Burning coal releases carbon dioxide and air pollutants.
Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Coal can be burned to produce heat for electricity generation. Certain coal is processed into coke used in many ironmaking processes.
Use and care. Not all steelmaking uses coal-derived coke. Burning coal releases carbon dioxide and air pollutants.

Build your explanation.

Natural gas can fuel cooking, heating, industry, and electricity generation. It can also supply raw material for making ammonia used in fertilizers.

Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. Natural gas can fuel cooking, heating, industry, and electricity generation. It can also supply raw material for making ammonia used in fertilizers.

Build your explanation.

Inspect the source and use records.
Source record. A plastic container may be collected for material recycling. Fuel burned for energy changes into other substances; collecting its exhaust does not turn it back into usable fuel.
Use and care. Renewable, reusable, and recyclable mean different things. Check both the material and the process.

Build your explanation.
Recycling a material is different from burning a fuel for energy.

Source record. A photovoltaic panel changes sunlight into electricity. A solar water heater instead uses sunlight to heat water.

Growing trees again does not immediately replace all the habitats and functions of an older forest.
Inspect the source and use records.

Reuse keeps an item in use. Repair restores function. Recycling processes materials into new products. Reducing unnecessary purchases avoids demand.

Inspect the source and use records.

Build your explanation.
